name: Pyaar Kii Ye Ek Kahaani
description: This supernatural series narrates the story of a vampire, Abhay who falls in love with Piya, a human and how they reunite despite all odds.

videos.title: Piya reaches Mount College
videos.overview: Piya reaches Dehradun from where Mount College is an hour away. On her way, Piya reminiscences the time she spent with her mother and vows to follow the values taught by her. Upon reaching the college, Piya catches Tanushree's attention and the latter, then instructs Misha, a fresher to rag Piya.

videos.title: Piya's abseiling nightmare
videos.overview: Misha, Piya and Kabir go abseiling together. Kabir tries to calm a scared and apprehensive Piya down. Later, Piya's rope breaks while abseiling, but a stranger rescues her. Meanwhile, as Misha and Piya's friendship grows stronger, Misha learns Piya's sad background.

videos.title: Tanushree insults Piya
videos.overview: Misha takes Piya home where she is introduced to Misha's mother and her sister, Panchi. Later, Misha takes Piya to her father's birthday party. Tanushree also comes to the birthday party. She insults Piya in front of everyone and Piya ends up crying.

videos.title: The police come to arrest Piya
videos.overview: Piya returns to her hostel where she finds her seniors drinking and doing drugs. Scared, she runs into the forest. There, she encounters Abhay, who asks her to leave the forest. Later, while auditioning for the Arts Club, the police arrive to arrest Piya on charges of selling drugs in the campus.

videos.title: Arnab Dobrial helps Piya
videos.overview: Piya is arrested. While she is in jail, she recalls the boy who saved her life and wonders where her destiny is taking her. Later, Misha's father, Arnab Dobrial gets the seniors arrested for selling the drugs and comes to take Piya home.

videos.title: Abhay's rudeness stuns everyone
videos.overview: Abhay makes his way to Mount College. While seeking admission, Abhay's arrogant behaviour irks the principal. His rudeness shocks everyone else in the college as well, including Piya. However, the students are left stunned to learn that the principal was fired for denying admission to Abhay.

videos.title: Piya goes to Abhay's home
videos.overview: Abhay wants to play the role of Romeo in the Drama Club. The other students continue to be furious at him because of his arrogance. Meanwhile, Piya goes to Abhay's home to return his phone which he had dropped in the college.

videos.title: Fight for Romeo's role
videos.overview: Abhay and Kabir both eye Romeo's role. Panchi asks the duo to enact a part from the play so that she can decide who fits the role better.

videos.title: Abhay bags Romeo's role
videos.overview: Abhay warns Piya of the consequences if she informs everyone about him saving her life. Panchi chooses Abhay over Kabir to play Romeo's role.

videos.title: The Raichands host a grand party
videos.overview: Everyone gears up for the party hosted by the Raichands. Kabir requests Piya to attend the party as his date.

videos.title: Abhay apologises to Piya
videos.overview: Piya expresses her hatred towards Abhay with Kabir and Misha. Kabir informs Mrs. Raichand about Abhay's rude behaviour towards Piya.

videos.title: Tanushree spikes Piya's drink
videos.overview: Tanushree spikes Piya's drink to teach her a lesson. Piya starts feeling dizzy when Tanushree drags her to dance

videos.title: Abhay gets Piya in trouble
videos.overview: On gaining consciousness, Piya requests Abhay not to take her to the hostel in a drunken state. But, Abhay does not oblige.

videos.title: Piya refuses to go out with Kabir
videos.overview: Abhay tells Mr. Raichand how much he hates Piya. He is stunned to see Piya visiting his house to offer her birthday cake.

videos.title: Abhay reveals the truth to Misha
videos.overview: Kabir writes a love letter for Piya and keeps it in Misha's locker by mistake. Misha is shocked to read the letter.

videos.title: Kabir's love letter
videos.overview: In the college, Kabir is shocked to see Ruhi, Tanushree and Prof Protima wearing yellow dresses. On seeing Piya in yellow as well, Kabir tells Danish that she has accepted his proposal.

videos.title: Abhay is mesmerised by Piya
videos.overview: During rehearsals, Abhay gets mesmerised by Piya. Annoyed with himself for showing his emotions to her, Abhay leaves the auditorium

videos.title: Misha's birthday party
videos.overview: Piya discusses the ancient history of Dehradun and her past with Arnab, but does not reveal that he is her father.

videos.title: The Raichands warn Abhay
videos.overview: At Misha's birthday party, as Arnab plays old birthday videos of Misha, Piya and Kabir fight with each other for dressing up like a pirate.

videos.title: Maya is pregnant!
videos.overview: Kabir's love letter causes a stir between Misha, Ruhi and Tanushree. Later, Panchi, Misha and Piya are shocked to learn that Maya is pregnant.

videos.title: Piya is onto something
videos.overview: While Piya and Panchi go to drop an intoxicated Kabir and Danish, their car breaks down in the forest.

videos.title: Tanushree's sinister ploy
videos.overview: Piya tries to overhear Maya and Abhay's conversation. Later, Piya tells Maya that she knows that Abhay is the father of her child.

videos.title: Arnab grows suspicious
videos.overview: Arnab learns that Mrs. Raichand tried to burn a book from his collection and grows suspicious about her.

videos.title: Abhay is worried
videos.overview: Abhay reminds himself that Piya is not Maithili and that he needs to control himself. Kabir, Piya, Abhay and Tanushree make it to the opening of the restaurant.

videos.title: Abhay warns Piya
videos.overview: When Maya cries in front of Piya for being fooled by the man she loved, Piya realises that her mother was betrayed in the same manner.

videos.title: Madhu learns Piya's truth
videos.overview: Maya tells Piya that she is going to ask Abhay to choose between her and his girlfriend.

videos.title: Danish's behaviour upsets Panchi
videos.overview: Mrs. Raichand is shocked to learn that Abhay is taking part in a boxing match. She reminds him that his touch can kill a human.

videos.title: Abhay and Kabir's fight
videos.overview: Kabir's friends instigate him to fight against Abhay in the boxing match. Worried about Abhay, Piya enters the boys' locker-room looking for him.

videos.title: Piya wants Abhay arrested
videos.overview: Madhu tells Piya that she knows that Piya is Sugandh's daughter. Later, Piya tells the police that Abhay is behind Maya's condition and asks them to arrest him.

videos.title: Maya has a miscarriage
videos.overview: While everyone gears up for the play, Panchi learns that Abhay cannot make it to the same.

videos.title: Who will play Romeo now?
videos.overview: While Abhay is seen cleaning a knife covered with blood, Maya receives a threatening call from her lover.

videos.title: Panchi's play wins first prize
videos.overview: Kabir and Misha both play Romeo's role. Eventually, Panchi's tragic play turns out to be a comedy and she bags the first prize.

videos.title: Danish proposes Panchi!
videos.overview: Panchi accepts Danish's marriage proposal.

videos.title: Panchi and Danish's engagement
videos.overview: With the help of a spy cam, Piya tries to make Abhay confess his crimes.

videos.title: Piya tries to uncover the truth
videos.overview: Piya suspects that Abhay had lied to her earlier and asks him again if he was really the father of Maya's child.

videos.title: Piya is shocked and confused
videos.overview: Piya goes to meet Maya at the hospital to ask her the name of the person responsible for her current state.

videos.title: Piya confronts Danish
videos.overview: Abhay is furious to learn that Danish was responsible for Maya's condition. Piya plans to tell Misha the truth, but Panchi interrupts her.

videos.title: Danish threatens Piya
videos.overview: On learning that Piya knows the truth, Danish threatens her. Abhay grabs him by his throat and instructs him to apologise to Piya.

videos.title: Maya destroys the proof
videos.overview: While searching for some proof in Danish's room, Abhay finds Maya and Danish's photo. Later, Piya shows the photo to Maya.

videos.title: Maya puts the blame on Abhay
videos.overview: Piya informs Danish's parents about his alleged relationship with Maya. They are both heartbroken. Meanwhile, Panchi calls a counsellor named Noor to help Maya.

videos.title: Danish accuses Piya
videos.overview: On seeing Danish at Piya's hostel, Abhay suspects that he's there to attack her and takes Piya to his house.

videos.title: Danish searches Piya's room
videos.overview: Suspecting that Piya might have some proof against him, Danish searches her room.

videos.title: The Principal insults Piya
videos.overview: Abhay rubbishes the principal's accusation that he spent the night with Piya. Arnab defends Piya and demands the principal to prove the same.

videos.title: Misha tries to find out the truth
videos.overview: Piya's hostel warden finds an envelope with a cheque signed by Danish in Maya's name. The warden calls Piya and enquires about the cheque.

videos.title: Piya tells Misha the truth
videos.overview: Abhay promises Piya that he will always be with her. Arnab gets furious on listening to Piya's accusations against Danish.

videos.title: Abhay saves Misha
videos.overview: Abhay predicts an earthquake just minutes before it occurs. He warns everyone and asks them to hide under the benches.

videos.title: Piya finds Abhay's pen
videos.overview: Abhay learns that Piya has access to the locker room's CCTV footage and stops her from watching it.

videos.title: Abhay confronts Piya
videos.overview: Assuming that Piya is going to expose him, Abhay confronts her and tells her that he regrets saving her life in the past.

videos.title: Piya's new look irks Abhay
videos.overview: Piya straightens her hair, which reminds Abhay of Maithili. Irked with her new look, he confronts her.

videos.title: Danish's bachelor party
videos.overview: Abhay overhears Misha and Piya's plan for Danish's bachelor party. Later, Danish learns that Maya is missing.

videos.title: Piya slaps Abhay
videos.overview: Abhay gets angry with Piya for dancing at the bachelor party. She slaps him when he calls her cheap. He saves Piya from a drunkard.

videos.title: Misha's pajama party
videos.overview: Chand tells Haseena about Danish's arrest. Misha organizes a pajama party and plans to summon spirits. Piya wants to call Maithili's spirit.

videos.title: Misha shocks everyone
videos.overview: Arnab confronts Abhay for Mr. Raichand bailing Danish out.

videos.title: Kabir's gift for Piya
videos.overview: Abhay gets angry with Danish for speaking ill of Piya. Kabir gifts a pendant to Piya.

videos.title: The game of truth or dare
videos.overview: Abhay talks rudely to Piya and hurts her feelings. He tells her that she is like any other girl who is trying to throw herself at him.

videos.title: Abhay is afraid of the wolves
videos.overview: Haseena and Chand are shocked to see the news about the arrival of wolves in the area near the river.

videos.title: Ruhi is abducted
videos.overview: Abhay and Piya are shocked when they realise they're surrounded by wolves. Piya hears Ruhi scream and follows the voice.

videos.title: Is Piya hallucinating?
videos.overview: Piya gets lost in the jungle and is surrounded by wolves again. She screams for help. Two strangers save her and later come towards her.

videos.title: Abhay fears the truth
videos.overview: Piya wonders what Abhay is scared of when he comes closer to her. Abhay knows that Piya will hate him if she finds out the truth about him.

videos.title: Piya gets lost in the fort
videos.overview: Abhay refuses to accompany the students to the fort. Piya is lost inside the fort.

videos.title: Maithali's painting
videos.overview: Abhay and Piya are leaving the forest when Abhay spots his father with the man who was trying to attack Piya.

videos.title: Piya is abducted
videos.overview: Abhay and Piya ask for a lift from three guys in a jeep. After some time, they pretend that their vehicle has broken down and ask Abhay to get some water.

videos.title: Abhay remembers his past
videos.overview: Abhay tells Piya that she is not safe. Piya panics when she finds out that her mother's pendant is missing. He goes in search of it.

videos.title: Abhay gets wounded
videos.overview: Abhay brings Piya's pendant wrapped in a cloth and returns it to her. He screams in pain when the chain and the pendant fall on his hand.

videos.title: Piya's research on vampires
videos.overview: Abhay comes to know that Piya is researching on vampires. Piya finds out through Misha that Arnab has a collection of books on vampires.

videos.title: Panchi and Misha's plan for Piya
videos.overview: Abhay refuses to help Piya when she says she's doing a research on vampires. Panchi and Misha want to bring Abhay and Piya closer.

videos.title: Abhay holds the silver glass
videos.overview: Panchi does a little cheating and pairs up Abhay and Piya for the dance.

videos.title: Arnab looks out for Piyali
videos.overview: Arnab wonders why Sugandh lied to him. He is still in search of Piyali. The students are asked about their research topic.

videos.title: Abhay's birthday
videos.overview: Abhay warns Piya about her research on vampires and says that it's dangerous.

videos.title: Piya seeks Arnab's help
videos.overview: Arnab tells Madhu that his daughter is alive. Madhu lies to Arnab when she receives a call from Piya's orphanage.

videos.title: The history of Pandher
videos.overview: Abhay tells Piya that Pandher is his topic for research. Haseena meets Piya in college and gives her an invitation card for Abhay's birthday party.

videos.title: Piya visits the old palace
videos.overview: Piya is unable to read the book because of the language it was written in.

videos.title: Abhay's birthday party
videos.overview: Piya learns that Abhayendra, in an attempt to save Maithali, also died in the fire.

videos.title: Piya's special gift for Abhay
videos.overview: Abhay feels that he saw Maithali in the house. He reminds Chand that this is the same date on which Maithali died.

videos.title: Maithali's spirit returns!
videos.overview: Abhay is happy when he thinks Maithali is around. Piya heaves a sigh of relief as she was almost caught by Abhay.

videos.title: Piya hides in Abhay's closet
videos.overview: Misha sets a challenge for Angad and Shaurya. The winner will take Ruhi out on a date. Angad wins the challenge with the help of a coin.

videos.title: Piya plays games with Abhay
videos.overview: Piya lands up in Abhay's room and behaves like Maithali. Abhay is furious on seeing Piya play games with him.

videos.title: Abhay leaves Piya in a cave
videos.overview: Abhay takes Piya to a cave and yells at her for acting like Maithali. Piya questions him about the Raichands.

videos.title: Abhay is guilty for leaving Piya
videos.overview: The next morning, Abhay comes to take Piya away from the cave. Later, when he sees her in the college he feels guilty for hurting her and apologises to her.

videos.title: Raichands decide to leave city
videos.overview: The Raichands decide to leave the city. Abhay is heartbroken at the thought of leaving Piya.

videos.title: Abhay misses Piya
videos.overview: Abhay is unable to stop thinking about Piya and has a strong urge to meet her. Piya assumes that Abhay left the city because of her.

videos.title: Piya meets with an accident
videos.overview: Arnab is disappointed to learn that Piyali was sent to another orphanage and that there's no written record of it.

videos.title: Arnab donates blood to Piya
videos.overview: Kabir sees Piya lying in a pool of blood and immediately rushes her to the hospital. Arnab donates blood to Piya and on seeing this, Madhu decides to tell him the truth.

videos.title: Abhay kisses Piya's wounds away
videos.overview: Abhay is upset to see Piya's unconscious state. He kisses her wounds away and promises to be by her side forever.

videos.title: Abhay suspects foul play
videos.overview: Abhay's instincts tell him that somebody tried to kill Piya and it wasn't an accident.

videos.title: Piya visits the forest
videos.overview: Piya is curious to learn about Abhay's reality. She recalls Maithali's story and goes to the forest.

videos.title: Abhay, the vampire
videos.overview: In a bid to reveal Abhay's true identity, Piya goes to the same place where Maithali was burnt and waits for Abhay to come.

videos.title: Piya leaves Dehradun
videos.overview: A petrified Piya decides to leave Dehradun and talks about the same to her principal.

videos.title: Piya decides to return
videos.overview: Misha learns that Piya has left the college. Abhay goes to meet Piya at the bus stop, but doesn't stop her from leaving.

videos.title: Raichands confront Abhay
videos.overview: The Raichands are shocked to see Piya alive. They question Abhay on whether he revealed his true identity to Piya.

videos.title: Misha and Ruhi's war
videos.overview: Misha and Ruhi both strive hard to win over Shaurya. Ruhi takes Tanushree's help for the same.

videos.title: Abhay, Piya get stuck in elevator
videos.overview: An attractive woman enters the college. Kabir and his friends are stunned to learn that she's the new sports teacher.

videos.title: A new task for Panchi
videos.overview: Panchi finds Siddharth's watch. He instructs her to fix it and convince the girl who had his watch to not be upset with him.

videos.title: The basketball match
videos.overview: Abhay beats Kabir in a basketball match. Shanaya asks Abhay to join the team, but he refuses.

videos.title: Abhay questions Piya
videos.overview: Abhay confronts Piya about the childhood video again. She asks him to leave her alone.

videos.title: Piya's childhood video
videos.overview: Abhay manages to retrieve the data from Piya's childhood video, but the visuals are unclear.

videos.title: The fashion show
videos.overview: Abhay informs Piya that he knows who her father is. A touched Piya cries and hugs him.

videos.title: Shanaya cozies up to Abhay
videos.overview: In the boys' locker room, Shanaya tries to get close to Abhay. Piya sees this and angrily rushes out.

videos.title: Misha's victory party
videos.overview: Arnab decides to throw a party to celebrate Misha's win in the fashion show.

videos.title: Abhay learns the truth
videos.overview: Abhay learns that Arnab is Piya's father. He asks her why she's living a life of an orphan.

videos.title: Valentine's Day celebrations
videos.overview: On Valentine's Day, Siddharth informs Panchi that they have to leave for a business trip that evening.

videos.title: The college's new 'Best Couple'
videos.overview: In this Valentine's Day special episode, Abhay and Piya are asked questions about each other.

videos.title: Praveen insults Arnab
videos.overview: When Arnab spots Praveen and asks him about Piya's whereabouts, Praveen insults him.

videos.title: Piya's scholarship is rejected
videos.overview: Abhay confronts Praveen for rejecting Piya's scholarship. Meanwhile, Misha informs Arnab that Piya was not being awarded the scholarship but forgets to disconnect the call.

videos.title: Piya is in trouble
videos.overview: Piya tells Arnab that he has no place in her life and will continue to consider herself as an orphan.

videos.title: Danish, Siddharth get into fight
videos.overview: At the auction, Danish misbehaves with Panchi. When Siddharth warns Danish, the latter tries to attack him but gets overpowered.

videos.title: Abhay confronts Siddharth
videos.overview: Siddharth guides a girl to reach the city through the forest and preys upon her. Trusting his instincts, Abhay realises he has to protect Piya from Siddharth.

videos.title: Piya applies for internship
videos.overview: Panchi explains to Piya, the advantages of college placements.

videos.title: Piya is disheartened
videos.overview: Abhay is shocked to see Piya in the locker room. He tells her that he was expecting Shanaya and not her.

videos.title: Abhay confides in Haseena
videos.overview: Abhay tells Haseena that Siddharth is back to take revenge but tells her that he will save his love this time.

videos.title: Piya goes missing
videos.overview: Abhay comes to meet Piya at the hostel. However, Arnab stops him from meeting her and tells him that he saw Abhay driving away after Piya's accident instead of helping her.

videos.title: Abhay rescues Piya
videos.overview: Chand finds Haseena in a sad state because of Siddharth. Meanwhile, when Piya regains consciousness, she asks Abhay why they're in a forest.

videos.title: Siddharth invites Piya to party
videos.overview: Chand reminds Abhay and Haseena that Siddarth is not as powerful as they assume him to be.

videos.title: Piya throws away the locket
videos.overview: Abhay takes Piya away from Siddharth's house just before Siddharth sees her. She is furious at Abhay and argues with him.

videos.title: Piya misunderstands Siddharth
videos.overview: Abhay is shocked to see Siddharth and Piya together. Angad and Ruhi scare T while she is walking alone through the forest.

videos.title: Misha doubts Shankar
videos.overview: Abhay calls Panchi's office and is shocked to hear Piya's voice. Meanwhile, Misha follows Shankar as she thinks he is a murderer.

videos.title: Siddharth challenges Abhay
videos.overview: When Abhay warns Siddharth, he takes it as a challenge and tells Abhay about trapping Piya. Panchi scolds T for being late to work.

videos.title: The police suspects Abhay
videos.overview: Abhay follows Shanaya into the forest and finds out that she's working for Siddharth. Abhay joins Siddharth's office to protect Piya.

videos.title: Abhay is in trouble
videos.overview: Shanaya complains against Abhay at the police station.

videos.title: Siddharth conspires against Abhay
videos.overview: Piya is upset by Abhay's behaviour. Kabir finds Piya on a lonely road and begins talking to her. The Dobrials are shocked with Misha's new avatar.

videos.title: Mr Raichand is angry at Siddharth
videos.overview: Mr. Raichand warns Abhay about Siddharth and expresses concern over Siddharth's plotting. Siddharth and Shanaya discuss their plans.

videos.title: Abhay's innocence is proven
videos.overview: Siddharth plans another move against Abhay. Abhay becomes the talk of Mount College for being arrested.

videos.title: Mr & Mrs Raichand are worried
videos.overview: Mr and Mrs Raichand discuss the feud between the brothers. They try to reason with Abhay, who is determined to fight it out.

videos.title: Exam preparations are on
videos.overview: Everybody at Mount College is preparing for the exams. Mr. Raichand meets the new trustee of Mount College. Panchi and Siddharth visit Mount College.

videos.title: Piya is sent to the principal
videos.overview: Tanushree plays foul, gets Piya in trouble and she is sent to the principal. Abhay stands by Piya and the entire class vouches for her too.

videos.title: Panchi is disheartened
videos.overview: Arnab, Panchi and Misha come to the same hotel and see Siddharth and Piya enjoying dinner. Panchi feels miserable, seeing the duo together.

videos.title: Siddharth lies to Piya
videos.overview: Panchi apologises to Piya for misunderstanding that she was trying to romance Siddharth.

videos.title: Abhay realises Sidhharth's ploy
videos.overview: Chand stops the fight between Abhay and Siddharth by showing the ring to Siddharth. Chand's instincts tell him that the duo will fight.

videos.title: Piya falls into trap
videos.overview: Abhay takes the responsibility to drop T safely home. T misunderstands the situation.

videos.title: Panchi becomes Siddharth's date
videos.overview: As the trustee of the college, Siddharth has to attend the prom night. He asks Panchi to be his date. As per his plan, Panchi falls for him.

videos.title: Trouble over the prom
videos.overview: Abhay is shocked when T tells him that she saw what happened between him and Siddharth in the forest.

videos.title: Panchi suspects Piya
videos.overview: Haseena returns after meeting Siddharth and lies to Chand about where she went. Chand tells her that she'd be called a traitor if she were to support Siddharth.

videos.title: Prom night
videos.overview: Abhay comes to pick up T on prom night while Misha and Ruhi's dates are Shankar and Shaurya. Ruhi gets close to Shankar to make Angad jealous.

videos.title: Misha's heartbreak
videos.overview: Abhay attends prom because he's aware that Siddharth is planning something against Piya. He recalls how he found out about Haseena meeting Siddharth.

videos.title: Piya is in danger
videos.overview: Abhay realises that it's a full moon night and fears that Siddharth may attack Piya.

videos.title: Abhay confronts Siddharth
videos.overview: Abhay confronts Siddharth, who sees Piya coming and pretends that Abhay was about to attack him.

videos.title: Piya is bitten
videos.overview: Abhay brings Piya home. Chand and Haseena are shocked to find that Abhay has bitten Piya.

videos.title: Siddharth is enraged
videos.overview: Abhay drops an unconscious Piya to the hostel. Meanwhile, Siddharth is furious about the whole incident.

videos.title: Panchi thanks Piya
videos.overview: Panchi apologises to Piya and thanks her for arranging a romantic date for her and Siddharth.

videos.title: Abhay's confession
videos.overview: Abhay tells Piya that he has always loved her and will continue to do so. Haseena meets Siddharth.

videos.title: Siddharth meets Haseena
videos.overview: Chand argues with Haseena for trying to protect Siddharth. Later, Siddharth meets Haseena and asks her to be on his side.

videos.title: The pyjama party
videos.overview: Misha flees detention when the lecturer falls asleep. She messages everyone that a fortune teller, Romanova, is coming to their pyjama party.

videos.title: Piya loses sleep
videos.overview: Abhay informs Chand that Piya's preliminary symptoms are becoming stronger by the day and that she is unable to sleep at night.

videos.title: A secret about Shaurya
videos.overview: Auditions are on for a dance competition. Misha is in charge and she pairs Piya with Kabir on purpose. Misha is taken aback when Piya tells her that Shaurya is gay.

videos.title: Abhay is jealous
videos.overview: Abhay asks Misha about his dance partner. T forces herself to be his partner. Abhay is jealous when Piya is paired with Kabir.

videos.title: Piya craves for blood
videos.overview: Misha feels Piya needs to be in a stable relationship. Kabir saves Piya from falling while dancing. Piya bumps into her hostel-mate, whose nail breaks and she begins bleeding.

videos.title: Misha's offer to Kabir
videos.overview: Misha makes Kabir and Piya the showstoppers of the dance competition. She asks them to practise after college hours. This makes Abhay jealous.

videos.title: Misha flirts with Abhay
videos.overview: Danish meets Arnab and Madhu to tell them that he doesn't think Siddharth is a good man. Arnab throws him out of the house. Misha

videos.title: Piya's sunburn
videos.overview: Abhay is worried about the day Piya will realise that she is turning into a vampire.

videos.title: Danish warns Panchi
videos.overview: Arnab suggests that they should invite Siddharth's parents for the party in the evening. Panchi refuses to do so, but Arnab and Madhu insist.

videos.title: Arnab, Madhu's anniversay
videos.overview: Arnab and Madhu speak to Siddharth's parents. Arnab is struck by doubt when Siddharth's father says he has studied in Kolkata while Siddharth had said he had studied in Ahmedabad.

videos.title: Misha pushes Piya
videos.overview: Abhay steals the CD that is to be played at the party. Misha catches him in the study and confronts him. Misha is taken aback when Piya comes to Abhay's rescue.

videos.title: Abhay wants to save Piya
videos.overview: Abhay asks Chand and Haseena to leave as he wants to save Piya. He wants Piya to survive the night as she will then become human again

videos.title: The Raichands are shocked
videos.overview: Arnab and Madhu come to take Piya from the Raichand house. Chand and Haseena refuse to let them take her.

videos.title: Misha humiliates Piya
videos.overview: Misha avoids talking to Piya and humiliates her in front of the whole class. Piya assures Chand and Haseena that she will keep their secret.

videos.title: T hatches a plot
videos.overview: Piya tries to justify her actions, but Misha refuses to listen. Piya is sad and cries in front of Abhay. Misha receives a message from T asking her to meet her to discuss a plan.

videos.title: Abhay, Piya perform well
videos.overview: Abhay and Piya put on a great performance. Angad and Ruhi thank Kabir for letting Abhay be Piya's dance partner.

videos.title: Dance results are announced
videos.overview: Danish proves to Arnab that Siddharth was plotting to prevent Mount College from winning the contest.

videos.title: Complaint against Siddharth

videos.overview: Maithili orders Abhay to kill Piya. Abhay gains consciousness and reveals that he was controlled by someone else.

videos.title: Maithili hypnotizes Abhay
videos.overview: Maithili hypnotises Abhay and takes control over him. She then orders him to kill Piya. Panchi and Danish bring Misha and Kabir closer.

videos.title: Dipanita tries to kill Abhay
videos.overview: Dipanita plans to kill Abhay. The vampires are getting ready to save Abhay from the werewolves. Abhay cannot bring himself to kill Piya.

videos.title: Maithili impersonates Piya
videos.overview: Maithili casts a spell on Piya and she is rendered helpless. Maithili assumes Piya's identity and tries to get information about the potion from Abhay.

videos.title: The werevolves attack Abhay
videos.overview: Jeh is unhappy about his mother's deception and is concerned about Piya's safety. Arnab rushes with his daughters and Piya to get them out of danger.

videos.title: Haseena kills Dipanita
videos.overview: Haseena kills Dipanita. Jeh is furious seeing his mother dead. Arnab discovers Piya lying in the washroom; realises it is Maithili, who is with Misha and Panchi.

videos.title: Jeh murders Abhay
videos.overview: Abhay revives Piya. Later Jeh, who is under Maithili's spell, steps in and kills Abhay. The Raichands take away his body.

videos.title: Can the potion revive Abhay?
videos.overview: Elina and Piya are looking for the potion but Maithili is watching them. Chand decides to go the restaurant, where Abhay was killed to look for clues. He finds a clue related to the tantrik.

videos.title: Jeh befriends Maithili
videos.overview: Jeh encounters Maithili at the cemetery and decides to be friends with her. Piya is sad after all the unfortunate events that have taken place in her family.

videos.title: The potion is with Piya
videos.overview: The Raichand couple approach Sardar for help. Piya finds the potion at the cemetery. Sardar agrees to help the Raichands but lies to them and does not intend to bring Abhay back to life.

videos.title: The vampires try to revive Abhay
videos.overview: The vampire clan assemble at the Raichand house to revive Abhay. Haseena informs Chand about the sign being used by the vampires.

videos.title: Piya turns Jeh against Maithili
videos.overview: Piya tries to win Jeh's trust and convinces him that Maithili can't be trusted. Arnab advises the Raichands to participate with the vampires and utter the reverse chant.

videos.title: What sacrifice must Abhay make?
videos.overview: Abhay comes back to life. Maithili instructs Sardar to kill Abhay. After much persuasion by the Raichands, Jeh agrees to help them get back Abhay's body.

videos.title: Panchi cannot be revived
videos.overview: Jeh fights the vampires while Piya escapes the Raichands' house. Chand and Haseena poison the vampires' minds against Maithili.

videos.title: Piya and Abhay start over
videos.overview: Abhay revisits his past. He feels guilty about not being of any help to his parents. Jeh plans to kill Abhay.

videos.title: Jeh seeks vengence
videos.overview: Piya tell Madhu she is getting married. Abhay denies having gone to Dehradun with Piya.

videos.title: Will the agent find Abhay?
videos.overview: Piya spends time with Abhay. Jeh gives the agent looking for Abhay an ultimatum to find him in three days.

videos.title: Jeh turns up at Piya's college
videos.overview: Misha invites Elina to her engagement party but she says Jeh would never allow her to go.

videos.title: Abhay protects Piya
videos.overview: Jeh senses Abhay in the college. Jeh asks the principal for the students' records.

videos.title: Who is the new Sardar?
videos.overview: Abhay convinces Piya to go back and meet her family. Haseena is in a bad state but Chand asks her to keep fighting.

videos.title: Jeh traps Piya
videos.overview: Jeh abducts Piya. Abhay feels helpless as Piya goes missing and he is unable to connect to Piya's mind.

videos.title: Can Jeh trace Abhay's hideout?
videos.overview: Jeh frightens Piya and informs her about the call that he had received from Abhay.

videos.title: Abhay asks the vampires to help
videos.overview: Elina tries peeping into the store room but she fails to see Piya. She regrets doubting Jeh and hands-over the locket.

videos.title: Jeh confesses his love to Piya
videos.overview: Abhay is shocked to see Arnab as the sardar of the vampires. Sardar Arnab tells Abhay how he sold his soul to the clan to save Panchi.

videos.title: Elina tells Abhay where Jeh is
videos.overview: Jeh expresses his love to Piya and regrets kidnapping her. As Jeh orders his men to hunt down Abhay, Elina follows him.

videos.title: Will Abhay surrender?
videos.overview: An aggressive Jeh is amused seeing Abhay with Chand and Haseena coming to Piya's rescue.

videos.title: And all's well that ends well
videos.overview: Abhay insists Arnab stay back with his family. But Arnab asks Abhay to stay with Piya.

videos.title: Abhay and Piya Get Married
videos.overview: Abhay arrives at Piya's house with Haseena and Chand for the wedding ceremony. Piya asks Misha to get a picture of Abhay in his wedding attire.
